extension.description: Manage persistent tmux, psmux, zmx, screen, Zellij, Herdr, shpool, abduco and a4 sessions in one terminal dock.
config.language: MuxDock interface language. Auto follows the editor. Changes apply immediately without disconnecting sessions. Command titles and setting descriptions always follow the editor language.
config.showTabs: Show open terminal tabs above the terminal.
config.maxTabs: Maximum open terminal tabs, even when tabs are hidden. Older tabs are disconnected when the limit is exceeded; background sessions keep running.
config.visibleManagers: Managers displayed in the sidebar, in list order. An empty list hides all managers without affecting open terminals.
config.showUnavailable: Show managers that are not installed.
config.refreshInterval: Session refresh interval in seconds while the panel is visible.
config.fontSize: Terminal font size in pixels. Changes apply immediately.
config.fontFamily: Terminal font. Leave empty to use the editor's terminal font. Changes apply immediately.
config.scrollback: Number of terminal history lines retained per connection.
config.executables: Absolute paths to manager executables, e.g. {"tmux": "/opt/homebrew/bin/tmux"}.
config.arguments: Global manager arguments, e.g. {"tmux": ["-L", "work"]}. Each array item is passed as a separate argument.
config.defaultDirectory: Working directory for new sessions. Leave empty to use the workspace or home directory.
